tasks.command: & { $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $env:JAVA_HOME='C:\Program Files\Android\Android Studio\jbr'; $env:ANDROID_HOME=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Android\sdk'; $env:ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=$env:ANDROID_HOME; $adb=Join-Path $env:ANDROID_HOME 'platform-tools\adb.exe'; $serial='emulator-5582'; $avd='community_membership_20260923'; $name=@(& $adb -s $serial emu avd name | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ -ne 'OK' -and $_ -ne '' }); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $name.Count -ne 1 -or $name[0] -ne $avd) { throw 'Unexpected test emulator' }; $owned=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^qemu-system-x86_64(-headless)?\.exe$' -and $_.CommandLine -match ('-avd\s+' + [regex]::Escape($avd) + '\b') -and $_.CommandLine -match '-read-only' -and $_.CommandLine -match '-no-snapshot-save' -and $_.CommandLine -match '-port\s+5582\b' }); if ($owned.Count -ne 1) { throw 'A single read-only test emulator on port 5582 is required' }; $boot=(& $adb -s $serial shell getprop sys.boot_completed | Out-String).Trim(); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $boot -ne '1') { throw 'Emulator has not completed boot' }; & $adb -s $serial shell cmd connectivity airplane-mode enable; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Cannot enable guest airplane mode' }; & $adb -s $serial shell svc wifi disable; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Cannot disable test Wi-Fi' }; & $adb -s $serial shell svc data disable; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Cannot disable test mobile data' }; & $adb -s $serial shell settings put global mobile_data 0; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Cannot turn off the mobile data setting' }; $wifi=(& $adb -s $serial shell cmd wifi status | Out-String).Trim(); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $wifi -notmatch 'Wifi is disabled') { throw 'Wi-Fi is not confirmed disabled' }; $mobile=(& $adb -s $serial shell settings get global mobile_data | Out-String).Trim(); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $mobile -ne '0') { throw 'Mobile data is not confirmed disabled' }; & $adb -s $serial shell wm size 640x1280; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Cannot set the 320 dp fixture viewport' }; & $adb -s $serial shell wm density 320; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Cannot set fixture density' }; $fontBefore=(& $adb -s $serial shell settings get system font_scale | Out-String).Trim(); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Cannot read original font scale' }; & .\android\gradlew.bat -p android :app:assembleDebug :app:assembleDebugAndroidTest --offline --console=plain; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Native test build failed' }; & $adb -s $serial install -r --no-incremental .\android\app\build\outputs\apk\debug\app-debug.apk; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Debug update failed' }; & $adb -s $serial install -r --no-incremental .\android\app\build\outputs\apk\androidTest\debug\app-debug-androidTest.apk; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Test update failed' }; $result=@(& $adb -s $serial shell am instrument -w -r -e community_disposable_ui_fixture true -e class com.community.platform.feature.spaces.SpaceScreenTest com.community.platform.debug.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner); $instrumentExit=$LASTEXITCODE; $result | Tee-Object -FilePath .\.local\ownership-native-offline-5582.txt; $fontAfter=(& $adb -s $serial shell settings get system font_scale | Out-String).Trim(); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $fontAfter -ne $fontBefore) { throw 'Original font-scale setting was not restored' }; $passes=@($result | Where-Object { $_ -match '^INSTRUMENTATION_STATUS_CODE: 0\s*$' }).Count; if ($instrumentExit -ne 0 -or $passes -ne 25 -or -not ($result -match '^OK \(25 tests\)\s*$') -or ($result -match '^INSTRUMENTATION_STATUS_CODE: -')) { throw 'Offline Space screen tests did not pass 25/25 without skips' }; Write-Output ('PASS: twenty-five offline Space tests; measured 320 dp / 200% dialog; font scale restored to ' + $fontAfter) }

args: import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'; import { createHash, randomUUID } from 'node:crypto'; import { existsSync, readFileSync, readdirSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'; import { join } from 'node:path'; const started = new Date().toISOString(); const legacy = '.local/blueprint-audit-2026-10-03T06-43-08-121Z-8476d422'; const clean = '.local/qualification-native-20261003T080428Z-8d71b86b'; const missing = '.local/blueprint-audit-2026-10-03T07-30-03-483Z-979da227'; const roots = [legacy, clean, missing]; const fingerprint = () => roots.flatMap(root => { const folder = join(root, 'android/app/build/test-results/testDebugUnitTest'); const files = ['manifest.json', 'android-result.json', 'full-result.json'].map(name => join(root, name)).filter(existsSync); if (existsSync(folder)) files.push(...readdirSync(folder).filter(name => name.endsWith('.xml')).map(name => join(folder, name))); return files.map(path => [path, createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(path)).digest('hex')]); }); const before = fingerprint(); const outcomes = []; const checks = [{ name: 'uncaught errors reject exit-zero assertions', root: legacy, exit: 1, tests: 583, uncaught: 2 }, { name: 'clean retained reports pass', root: clean, exit: 0, tests: 586, uncaught: 0 }, { name: 'old reports excluded by fresh-run boundary', root: clean, since: '2099-01-01T00:00:00.000Z', exit: 1 }, { name: 'UTC cutoff excludes older local-time reports', root: clean, since: '2026-10-03T08:11:00.000Z', exit: 1 }, { name: 'missing reports fail closed', root: missing, exit: 1 }]; for (const check of checks) { const args = ['.local/blueprint-audit-run.mjs', '--android-reports', check.root]; if (check.since) args.push(check.since); const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, args, { encoding: 'utf8' }); assert.equal(result.status, check.exit, result.stderr); const report = JSON.parse(result.stdout); assert.equal(report.passed, check.exit === 0); if (check.tests) { assert.equal(report.counts.tests, check.tests); assert.equal(report.counts.uncaughtClasses, check.uncaught); } outcomes.push({ name: check.name, command: [process.execPath, ...args], expectedExit: check.exit, exit: result.status, report }); console.log('PASS ' + check.name); } assert.deepEqual(fingerprint(), before); const evidence = join('.local', 'isolated-native-report-gate-' + started.replaceAll(/[:.]/g, '-') + '-' + randomUUID().slice(0, 8) + '.json'); const launcherSha256 = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync('.local/blueprint-audit-run.mjs')).digest('hex'); writeFileSync(evidence, JSON.stringify({ started, finished: new Date().toISOString(), launcherSha256, checks: outcomes, preservedFiles: before, passed: checks.length, failed: 0 }, null, 2) + String.fromCharCode(10), { flag: 'wx' }); console.log('5/5 report checks passed; original manifests, results and XML files unchanged.'); console.log('Evidence: ' + evidence);
